pdf_limited_structure: PDF page text and directly placed embedded raster images. Vector drawings and images nested in Form objects are not read; columns and tables may be misordered. Images follow page text, not reading order, and may be fragments. Check the original before relying on the result.
pdf_text_layout: Page visuals are retained. Extracted PDF text may have incorrect reading order or table relationships. A matching quotation validates the extracted words, not their visual arrangement. Check the retained page images for layout and context.
presentation_renderer_unavailable: Slide rendering was unavailable. Extracted text, tables, notes and supported embedded pictures are retained, but charts, drawn shapes and their relationships may be missing. Check the original presentation.
presentation_render_failed: Slide rendering did not complete. Extracted text, tables, notes and supported embedded pictures are retained, but charts, drawn shapes and their relationships may be missing. Check the original presentation.
unsupported_document_visual: A visual object was detected but not captured for analysis. It may be decorative or contain information. Compare captured content with the original document to check what is missing.
document_image_unavailable: An embedded image could not be decoded or converted. Its location is retained, but its visual content was not available for analysis. Check the original document.
